Check POWER data for any missing values

dot-check_na.Rd

Check POWER data for any missing values

Usage

.check_na(.wth)

Arguments

.wth

A data.frame object from nasapower::get_power with weather data for checking Checks the data returned from the POWER dataset and informs the user if missing values are found. It does not do anything other than emitting a message about missing data.

Value

Called for its side-effects, an invisible NULL.

Examples

wth <- setDT(
  nasapower::get_power(
    lonlat = c(121.25562, 14.6774),
    dates = "2000-06-30",
    community = "AG",
    pars = c(
      "T2M",
      "T2M_MIN",
      "T2M_MAX",
      "RH2M",
      "PRECTOTCORR"
    ),
    temporal_api = "DAILY"
  )
)
#> Error in setDT(nasapower::get_power(lonlat = c(121.25562, 14.6774), dates = "2000-06-30",     community = "AG", pars = c("T2M", "T2M_MIN", "T2M_MAX", "RH2M",         "PRECTOTCORR"), temporal_api = "DAILY")): could not find function "setDT"
